title: Steppe Eagle Hunting
tagline: Track the fox, release the eagle in the wind, stoop and call it home.
description: The Kazakh eagle hunters' winter steppe as a game of patience and timing. Track a fox, release a golden eagle at the right moment, steer it through the wind, stoop and call it back to the glove. Computer riders, two players, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Press and drag to keep the sight on the fox; the lock fills.
Release when the fox is out in open snow, far from its den.
Drag to steer through the wind; tap Stoop at about 30 m.
Tap Call as each ring closes for a clean return.
Tap Think for a tested suggestion.
